comment: 配音用 ElevenLabs（model + voices），tempo 是生成后用 ffmpeg atempo 加快的倍数（不变调）。anim: index.html 各段的动画时间边界；segments[i]: 第 i 段的聊天对白。每段成片时长 = max(动画时长, 对白总长)，段内动画线性拉伸。text 显示在气泡里；say 是给语音合成的读法（可带 eleven_v4 的 [laughs] 等音频标签），缺省用 text。

segments.text: Hey, are you the new robot everyone's talking about?
That's me, XGuard! I stop AI agents from overspending.
segments.say: [cheerful] That's me, X Guard! I stop AI agents from overspending.

segments.text: Wait, agents spend money now?
With x402, they do. That's why I'm here.
Honestly, I just let my agent pay for whatever it needs.
Bold. The price, the payee, even the data come from a server you don't trust.
So one shady merchant could drain me?
segments.say: [nervous laugh] So one shady merchant could drain me?

segments.text: Which is why I sit between the agent and the money.
Like a bouncer?
Pretty much. Small payments go through, big ones wait for you, sketchy ones stay out.
segments.say: [laughs] Pretty much. Small payments go through, big ones wait for you, sketchy ones stay out.

segments.text: Okay, my agent wants a report for 8 XRP.
segments.say: Okay, my agent wants a report for eight X R P.

segments.text: Network's fine, merchant's verified… but it's over the 1 XRP auto limit.
segments.say: Network's fine, merchant's verified... but it's over the one X R P auto limit.

segments.text: So?
Verdict: HOLD.
Hold for me?
For you. I explain the risk, you check the payee and amount on your Ledger, and hold to sign.
And if the data turns out to be junk?
Big buys sit in an XRPL escrow first. Good data gets paid, garbage gets refunded.
segments.say: Big buys sit in an X R P L escrow first. Good data gets paid, garbage gets refunded.

segments.text: Nice. No more pay and pray.
Okay, worst case: someone hacks the server.
My sentinel watches the ledger through Quicknode and flags the stray transfer.
Then I hit Contain?
Yep. Everything locks down, and the funds go back to the treasury.
How hard is it to plug you in?
Three lines of Python, or connect over MCP.
segments.say: Three lines of Python, or connect over M C P.

segments.text: That's shorter than my lunch order.
segments.say: [laughs] That's shorter than my lunch order.

segments.text: Any custom contracts in there?
Nope. All native XRPL.
segments.say: Nope. All native X R P L.

segments.text: So my agent pays on its own…
segments.say: So my agent pays on its own...

segments.text: …and you stay in control.
